integrity: All assertions refer to the exact stated interpolant. Finite tests supplement an analytical universal proof; originality is best-knowledge rather than a comprehensive historical priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform real finite paths, zero endpoint derivatives, minmod, and slope scale 0 through 3. Nonuniform meshes, other limiters, vector-valued data, and time evolution are not proved.
title: Sharp two-input bounded-variation sensitivity of minmod cubic Hermite interpolation
